name: dsh-vocab-review
description: Underlined-word vocabulary review for DeepSeek Harness: image ingestion for both underlined worksheets and plain article images (exam high-frequency words for 高考/CET-4/CET-6/考研, basic and out-of-scope words filtered), one-word-at-a-time quiz loop that keeps going while words are due, three-tier grading (known / half-known / unknown) with plugin-side verdict verification, per-word ease factors, persistent wrong-word ledger and weak-word book with CSV/JSON/Anki export, a last-7-days trend and diagnostics, daily quota, due reminders, and an optional self-hosted QQ bot (QQ 开放平台 AppID/AppSecret, no third-party plugin and no npm dependency, inbound text and images) or a bridge to the third-party dsh-qq-bot plugin.
author: At

scripts.test: node test/harness.mjs && node test/sessions-stop.mjs && node test/client-load-check.mjs && node test/qq-builtin.mjs
scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check qq/client.js && node --check qq/bridge.js
